Record notes

Twenty-one software workflows with complete native, Go, GitHub, local pipeline, MCP and debugging procedures.

Version 0.2.0 includes 21 complete skill procedures. Complete source methods, query/scaffolding helpers and synthetic fixtures; authorized Go corpus and platform providers supplied separately.

Requirements: Host coding tools; Runtime named by the selected workflow.

License scope: MIT AND Apache-2.0. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add development-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from ccfc84e7affdc6a0e9990f88e92e34829403d2ff. SHA-256: 37e01c2a8d9180a35dc948080d7467c6d367eb6e37653010338b8e67d935d365.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
